- **`working-on.md`** — now says the pause is over and screens are in scope, with the dashboard named as the highest-value target.
- **Today's session log** — the open thread corrected.
- **`logs/2026-08-17-2335-...`** — annotated inline rather than rewritten, since a log records what was true when written.

**Four things I kept as surviving the supersession**, because they were never really about the pause: the bar is "good enough to share" rather than finished; that bar applies to your wife too and you already declined an early deploy, so nobody should re-propose it; you gather direction yourself, so bring options to compare rather than a proposal to accept; and the "before" set at `.claude/plans/design/before/` is still the starting point.

Tell me if any of those four should have gone with it.

The remaining grep hit is the decision's own body text, which is correct — it's the historical record sitting under a superseded banner.
